title: Grow Therapy, which connects patients with therapists covered by their insurance, raised a $150M Series D at a $3B valuation and hits $1B+ in annual revenue (Rebecca Torrence/Bloomberg)
summary: Rebecca Torrence / Bloomberg: Grow Therapy, which connects patients with therapists covered by their insurance, raised a $150M Series D at a $3B valuation and hits $1B+ in annual revenue — Sequoia Capital-backed mental health startup Grow Therapy has reached a $3 billion valuation with new funding.
